name: allfish
description: AllFish — an AllTrails-style web app for anglers to discover water bodies (rivers, lakes, ponds) across the US & Canada, see cited fish-species data, and post reviews.

scripts.build:pages: npm run export:static && VITE_STATIC=1 npm --workspace client run build -- --base=./
scripts.build:firebase: npm run export:static && VITE_FIREBASE=1 npm --workspace client run build
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build:firebase && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run seed
